name: permission-request-chime
description: Play a local macOS sound when Codex asks you to approve a permission request.

interface.shortDescription: Play a macOS chime when Codex asks for permission.
interface.longDescription: Permission Request Chime (macOS) bundles a Codex PermissionRequest lifecycle hook that plays a local macOS sound when a request is routed to you for approval. Automatically reviewed requests stay silent. Install this version on macOS. Windows users should install Permission Request Chime (Windows).
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure the permission request chime.
